note_zh: v0.5 系变更回执。009 登记基准 v0.5.0 的条文变更（新增第六组件「双联交接台账」）；010 登记同一基准版本之下随包校验器的实现层加固——规范条文一字未改，seb-spec.json 仍为 v0.5.0，判据集合、违例码登记表与全部条文语义均未变动，因此不递增基准版本号，但变更同样立回执并公开登记失败样本。本文件因此不是「一版本一回执」，而是「v0.5.0 基准的条文变更与其实现层变更同处一卷」，两条共用包内统一编号序列。009 的变更来源为维护方兑现包内既有登记的待议项——正文自 v0.4 起把双联交接结构的升格提议按版本治理挂账为「v0.4 之后的待议项」，同期服务桌开办条件档案把四位序登记为「已确定的设计判据」而包内无任何判据载体。属「维护方自查」类驱动，治理回路第五次转动（前四次：桌面推演自查 v0.2、采用反馈 v0.3.0、独立审查 v0.3.1、外部方案对比 v0.4.0）。009 不引入任何新的设计主张：第六组件的全部字段与判据由包内既有素材推出，推出来源逐条登记。010 的变更来源为维护方对随包自检脚本自身的内部对抗性审计，是治理回路第六次转动，也是第一次把审计对象从「判据写得对不对」换成「自检本身证明了什么」。
note_en: v0.5-series change receipts. 009 registers the baseline text change of v0.5.0 (the sixth component, the two-part handover ledger); 010 registers a hardening of the shipped checkers' implementation under that same baseline version — no word of the specification changed, seb-spec.json remains v0.5.0, and the criteria set, the violation-code registry and every stated semantic stand, so the baseline version does not increment, yet the change carries a receipt and a published failed-sample register all the same. This file is therefore not one receipt per version but one volume holding both the text change of the v0.5.0 baseline and the implementation change beneath it, the two drawing on the package's single receipt-number series. The driver of 009 was the maintainer discharging an open item the package already registered — from v0.4 the prose carried the promotion of the two-part handover structure under version governance as an item pending beyond v0.4, while the service-desk readiness file registered the four stations as a settled design criterion with no criterion carrier anywhere in the package. That was a maintainer self-audit, the fifth turn of the governance loop (after the tabletop self-audit of v0.2, adoption feedback for v0.3.0, independent review for v0.3.1, and external comparison for v0.4.0), and it introduced no new design claim: every field and criterion of the sixth component is derived from material already in the package, with each derivation registered. The driver of 010 is the maintainer's internal adversarial audit of the shipped self-check scripts themselves, the sixth turn of the loop and the first to move the subject of audit from whether the criteria are right to what the self-check actually proves.

opinion.zh: 两处条文写了而判据没有。其一，人工接管在基准里只到「写下一个可被找到的角色」为止（node_schema.human_handoff），接手本身在运行层留下什么痕迹无人可判——一份把未决项在交接时清空、由同一角色对自己签署的交接单，在 v0.4.0 文本下完全合规。其二，服务桌四个位序被开办条件档案明文登记为「已确定的设计判据」，但该判据只存在于 PUBLIC-007 的要素属性与档案的散文描述里，没有任何实现读它，「顺序是判据而不是布置建议」这句话因此无处兑现。
opinion.en: In two places the text exists and the criterion does not. First, the baseline takes human takeover only as far as writing down a findable role (node_schema.human_handoff), leaving nothing to rule on what the takeover itself records: a slip whose open items are cleared at handover and which one role signs to itself is fully compliant under the v0.4.0 text. Second, the four service-desk stations are registered in the readiness file as a settled design criterion, yet that criterion lives only in the feature attributes of PUBLIC-007 and the file's prose, with no implementation reading it — so the sentence that the order is a criterion and not a layout suggestion has nowhere to land.

finding.zh: 逐项对照 v0.4.0 文本坐实为规范设计缺口而非实现缺陷：v0.4.0 的六个可判层面（节点 schema、评分口径、等级定义、判定规则、AI 权限边界、生命周期字段组）中没有任何一处涉及交接单据；四位序在 seb-spec.json 中零出现；正文交接段自身写明「本版不改动基准条文」，即该缺口是被登记而非被遗漏。另查明：交接结构与四位序两件事在包内同属大钟寺 JZ-04 一条线索（PUBLIC-007 承接 OP-04，服务桌安装其上），可由同一组件一并封闭，不需要两次版本递增。
finding.en: Checked item by item against the v0.4.0 text and confirmed as a specification gap rather than an implementation defect: none of the six rulable surfaces of v0.4.0 (node schema, scoring definitions, level definitions, decision rules, AI authority boundary, lifecycle field group) touches a handover slip, and the four stations appear nowhere in seb-spec.json; the prose's own handover paragraph states that the edition changes no baseline text, so the gap was registered rather than overlooked. Further established: the handover structure and the four stations belong to one thread in the package — JZ-04 at Dazhongsi, where PUBLIC-007 carries OP-04 and the desk sits on it — and can be closed by one component without two version increments.

change_made.summary_zh: 新增第六组件「双联交接台账」（handover_ledger），基准组件数由五增至六：十三个字段，七类 constraint_machine_rule，九个违例码。判据为——交出方与接收方须为不同角色（HANDOVER_ROLES_NOT_SEPARATED）；两方各自署名（HANDOVER_SIGNATURE_MISSING）；未决项随单移交、不得在交接时清空（HANDOVER_OPEN_ITEMS_CLEARED）；接收方在接收／拒收／暂缓三项中选一（HANDOVER_RECEIPT_ACTION_INVALID）；拒收与暂缓须写明理由且上一责任方继续在岗（HANDOVER_REFUSAL_UNSTAFFED）；必填字段缺失记 HANDOVER_FIELD_MISSING。服务桌四位序（SD-1 人工窗口→SD-2 多通道信息位→SD-3 AI 开关→SD-4 退出回执位）作为位序判据入条文：位序不可调换（HANDOVER_STATION_SEQUENCE_INVALID）、人工窗口先于一切 AI 构件设立（STAFFED_WINDOW_NOT_FIRST）、退出回执位在最后一步之后仍然在场（EXIT_RECEIPT_STATION_ABSENT）；三判据以 service_desk_present 为适用前提，不向没有服务桌的节点摊派。样例由四十条扩至六十条：十个 OP 节点各一条交接实例（五个必填字段逐字取自 geometry/constraints.geojson 并经来源对齐比对，各字段推出来源逐条登记在 handover_ledger.provenance），十条按 risk.json 风险注入的缺陷变体（每条只改一处判据输入，并逐字引用该风险的 pause_threshold）。桌面校验器升至 0.5.0 并执行六个组件；链复演器输入类型不含交接台账，九码结构性不触发，本版零改动并已复跑核实。v0.4.0 规范全文按字节入包为 visual/assets/seb-spec-v0.4.0.json 并登记哈希。
change_made.summary_en: A sixth component, the two-part handover ledger, takes the baseline from five components to six: thirteen fields, seven constraint_machine_rule types and nine violation codes. The criteria are that the handing-over and receiving parties must be different roles (HANDOVER_ROLES_NOT_SEPARATED); each signs (HANDOVER_SIGNATURE_MISSING); open items travel on the slip and are never cleared at handover (HANDOVER_OPEN_ITEMS_CLEARED); the receiver signs exactly one of accept, refuse or hold (HANDOVER_RECEIPT_ACTION_INVALID); a refusal or hold states a reason and keeps the previous party on duty (HANDOVER_REFUSAL_UNSTAFFED); and a missing required field records HANDOVER_FIELD_MISSING. The four service-desk stations (SD-1 staffed window, SD-2 multi-channel information point, SD-3 AI switch, SD-4 exit-receipt station) enter the text as sequence criteria: the order may not be rearranged (HANDOVER_STATION_SEQUENCE_INVALID), the staffed window is established before any AI component (STAFFED_WINDOW_NOT_FIRST), and the exit-receipt station is present after the last step (EXIT_RECEIPT_STATION_ABSENT); all three are conditioned on service_desk_present and are never levied on a node without a desk. The fixtures grow from forty to sixty: one handover instance per OP node (five required fields verbatim from geometry/constraints.geojson and compared by source alignment, every field's derivation registered in handover_ledger.provenance) and ten defect variants injected from the risk register (each altering exactly one criterion input and quoting that risk's pause_threshold verbatim). The tabletop checker rises to 0.5.0 and executes all six components; the chain replayer's input type holds no handover ledger, so the nine codes cannot fire there, and it needed no change, which was verified by replay. The full v0.4.0 spec ships byte-exact as visual/assets/seb-spec-v0.4.0.json with its hash registered.

not_adopted_reason.zh: verdict 为 adopted，本字段登记明确不追的三项，理由随之：①未决项不写条数——交接台账只声明有无，写成条数会在样例集内引入第一个计数，破坏 contains_no_measurement_values 的承诺与「分母只声明类别是否被声明」的表达纪律；②不对 handing_over_role 施加角色词表判据——角色词判据已由 node_schema.human_handoff 承担，在两处各设一关会使采用方的 adopter_lexicon 机制在两处行为分叉，同一份词表可能在一处通过、另一处不通过；③不把「两个不同写法指向同一个人」纳入机器判据——判据只裁取值是否字面相同这一机器可判下限，实质同一性属登记环节的人工复核，机器不代其结论。
not_adopted_reason.en: The verdict is adopted; this field registers three things expressly not taken up, with reasons. First, open items carry no count: the ledger declares only presence, and a count would introduce the first number into the fixture set, breaking the contains_no_measurement_values promise and the discipline by which denominators declare whether a category was declared and never a sample size. Second, no role-token criterion is placed on handing_over_role: that criterion already sits on node_schema.human_handoff, and a second gate would fork the adopter_lexicon mechanism between two places, letting one lexicon pass at one gate and fail at the other. Third, two different wordings naming the same person is not made machine-decidable: the criterion rules only on the floor of literal equality, and substantive identity stays with human review at registration, where the machine does not stand in for the conclusion.

raised_by.role_group_en: The maintainer's internal adversarial audit of the shipped self-check scripts themselves. The subject is the implementation of the two checkers, visual/assets/seb-tabletop-run.js and visual/assets/seb-op04-chain-run.js, and not the baseline text; the method applies mutations item by item to a read-only copy of the whole package and records exit codes and output differences, forty-four in all, with two aimed at the meta-check itself numbered separately. opinion.zh: 两个校验器的判定逻辑是真的，但「全部通过」这个结论不可信，两件事需要分开说。判定逻辑一侧，审计确认：判据由基准驱动而非写死在工具里，样例期望与判定实现不同源（削弱判据函数、删判定分支、改基准条文均产生不一致），几何篡改的灵敏度到毫米级（一个顶点位移一厘米即被捕获），证据链复演器以子进程真实执行桌面校验器并比对其退出码。结论一侧，同一批实验给出相反的证据：两个校验器都没有任何期望总数或下界断言，样例条目、声明条目、选点依据、几何线位乃至整张判定码登记表都可以消失而输出零变化——删掉整张登记表与删掉整条来源对齐判据这两次变异，产出与干净运行逐字节相同的输出并退出 0。一个只会通过的自检，与没有自检等价；更坏的是它把「没有检查」写成了「检查通过」，读者据以放心，而这份放心没有任何执行体支撑。
opinion.en: The verdict logic of the two checkers is real, and the conclusion that everything passed is not trustworthy; the two need saying separately. On the logic: the audit confirms that criteria are driven by the baseline rather than written into the tools, that fixture expectations and the verdict implementation draw on different sources (weakening a criterion function, deleting a verdict branch and editing the baseline text all produce disagreements), that sensitivity to geometry tampering runs to the millimetre (moving one vertex by a centimetre is caught), and that the chain replayer really executes the tabletop checker as a child process and compares its exit code. On the conclusion, the same experiments give the opposite evidence: neither checker carried an expected total or a floor assertion, and fixtures, claims, selection checks, centrelines and even the entire verdict-code registry could disappear with no change in the output — deleting the whole registry, and deleting the source-alignment criterion outright, each produced output byte-identical to a clean run at exit 0. A self-check that can only pass is equivalent to no self-check; worse, it writes "not checked" as "checked and passed", and a reader's resulting confidence rests on nothing executable.

finding.zh: 四十四组变异逐项实测坐实八类缺陷，均为实现层缺陷，无一涉及基准条文，因此本条回执不递增基准版本号。按证据强度排列：其一，无总数与下界断言（删一条样例得 59／59 退出 0，样例集清空得 0／0 退出 0，复制成一百二十条得 120／120 退出 0，删档案一行、清空选点依据、清空声明集同样退出 0）。其二，元检查在自己的输入缺席时把自己关掉（删整张登记表后桌面校验器输出逐字节不变、退出 0，而证据链复演器对同一输入退出 2——两实现当场分歧）。其三，可发码集合与实际发出的码不同源（未登记码在用而两个实现都报「全部登记」）。其四，档案自供容差无上界（全线读数偏差五十米仍报「读数不符项 0」）。其五，档案除以档案的重言式，且打印给读者的数字取自被审档案。其六，反例的期望理由码缺席即降级为只比判定。其七，条件式登记使整块校验随档案子键消失。其八，几何单向遍历配硬编码文案，缺一条路照常打印「五条中心线逐条一致」。另查明：包内 package-integrity-gates.json 的 PG-10 闸门明文承诺「判定码不在规范登记表内即失败」与「同一非法输入在两个实现下必须得到同一判定」，两句均被当场证伪，且该闸门登记的三组计数只是叙述文本，没有任何可执行体复核。修前退出码为 0 的漏检共十六项，是本条回执的量化基线。
finding.en: Forty-four mutations, each actually run, establish eight classes of defect, all in the implementation and none touching the baseline text, which is why this receipt does not increment the baseline version. In order of evidential force: first, no totals and no floor assertions (one fixture fewer gave 59 of 59 at exit 0, an empty set 0 of 0 at exit 0, a duplicated set 120 of 120 at exit 0, and deleting an archive row, emptying the selection checks or emptying the claim set all exited 0). Second, a meta-check switching itself off when its own input is absent (with the registry deleted the tabletop checker's output was byte-identical at exit 0 while the chain replayer refused the same input at exit 2 — the two disagreeing on the spot). Third, an emittable-code set drawn from a different source than the codes actually emitted (an unregistered code in use while both implementations reported all registered). Fourth, an archive-supplied tolerance with no ceiling (every figure off by fifty metres still reported as zero disagreements). Fifth, a tautology of archive over archive, with the figures printed for the reader taken from the audited archive. Sixth, an absent expected reason code degrading a counterexample to a verdict-only test. Seventh, conditional registration letting a whole check vanish with an archive sub-key. Eighth, one-directional traversal of the geometry paired with a hard-coded line, so that with a road missing the replayer still printed that all five centrelines matched. Further established: gate PG-10 of package-integrity-gates.json promises in as many words that a verdict code outside the registered table fails the gate and that the same illegal input must draw the same verdict from both implementations, and both promises were falsified on the spot, while the three sets of counts the gate registers were prose with nothing executable behind them. Sixteen missed detections exited 0 before the fix, and that is the quantified baseline of this receipt.

组件）。两个校验器为此各增一个只在显式传参时生效的码集导出分支（seb-tabletop-run.js 第 1170-1173 行、seb-op04-chain-run.js 第 688-691 行），默认运行输出一字不变。新基线读数：桌面校验器退出码 0，六十二条样例与期望 62／62 一致（通过 23、拒绝 39）；证据链复演器退出码 0，声明判定 4／4、读数不符项 0，其摘录的前置校验器行随之为 62／62；对拍脚本退出码 0，两实现可发码 40 与 23、基准登记表 40 个码双向相等，五组变异两实现同判。修前退出码为 0 的十六项漏检，修后无一项仍为 0。
change_made.summary_en: The change is a hardening of the implementation: not a word of seb-spec.json changed, the baseline remains v0.5.0, the criteria set, the violation-code registry and every stated semantic stand, and the fixture set gains two counterexamples with the original sixty untouched. The nine S1 defects, with their fixes and line numbers. S1-1, a meta-check switching itself off: lines 283-285 of seb-tabletop-run.js return "the registry is absent and the code self-check cannot run" and refuse the run instead of returning an empty list, matching the second implementation. S1-2, missing dynamic codes: the level-gate and denominator-integrity codes leave the literal table at line 154 (with the reason noted at lines 143-153) and are registered from baseline values at lines 258-261, with lines 649-656 of seb-op04-chain-run.js doing the same for field-rule codes and the level-gate code. S1-3, an uncapped tolerance: line 903 of seb-op04-chain-run.js sets MAX_TOLERANCE_M = 0.01 and lines 905-911 exit 2 above it. S1-4, archive over archive: from line 941 each row's computed values are kept, lines 984-987 print them, and the ratios at lines 1014-1023 read only from them. S1-5, a degraded counterexample: lines 1117-1133 require any claim expecting REJECT to carry a non-empty expected reason code. S1-6, vanishing derived sub-keys: lines 1001-1008 name the required keys as a constant list with at least one of the two approach-ratio conventions declared, and the conditionals at lines 1029 and 1039 move to !== undefined. S1-7, no totals and no floor: the fixture set declares expected_fixture_count 62, expected_accept_count 23 and expected_reject_count 39, lines 370-406 of seb-tabletop-run.js compare each against what ran and exit 2 on disagreement or emptiness, and lines 1336-1340 print the comparison as a readable figure; on the chain side lines 921-935 derive the expected rows from the implementation's state set crossed with the archive's task list and report missing, extra and duplicate rows, lines 745-752 and 1100-1111 set zero floors, identifier uniqueness and an at-least-one-counterexample floor for the selection checks and the claim set, and line 1181 adds a non-empty claim set to the closing condition. S1-8, one-directional geometry traversal: lines 798-812 compare the geometry centrelines, the archived length table and the AI-off classification table against one another in both directions. S1-9, no counterexample for source alignment: seb-tabletop-fixtures.json gains SM-N1 and SM-N2, covering the forced-alignment and declared-source sides, taking the set from sixty to sixty-two, while lines 1002, 1015, 1018, 1029 and 1055 of seb-tabletop-run.js mark the criterion as engaged and line 1316 counts how often it truly ran. The four S2 items. S2-1, bare parse failures: lines 1148-1163 of seb-tabletop-run.js catch the baseline and fixture parse failures as SPEC_UNREADABLE and FIXTURES_UNREADABLE at exit 2 and lines 1353-1359 wrap the entry point, while lines 98-108 of seb-op04-chain-run.js wrap its reader and lines 87-91 register an uncaught-exception handler, both at exit 2. S2-2, bare structural gaps: lines 329-337 of seb-tabletop-run.js list the seven component and field paths the tool actually dereferences, lines 339-368 report any absence as SPEC_STRUCTURE_INVALID, lines 370-406 check the per-fixture mandatory fields, and lines 423-424 place these prerequisites ahead of every criterion. S2-4, duplicate items: lines 378-386 of seb-tabletop-run.js and lines 1106-1108 of seb-op04-chain-run.js assert uniqueness of fixture and claim identifiers. S2-3 remains open; the reason is registered under not_adopted_reason. The three implementation-side S3 items. S3-1, the hard-coded five: line 817 of seb-op04-chain-run.js composes the success line from roads.length. S3-2, a self-check line contradicting the fact: the wording stands and what makes it true is now the shared source established by S1-2. S3-5, exit-code comments at odds with behaviour: the header comments of both tools (lines 55-72 of seb-tabletop-run.js and lines 52-69 of seb-op04-chain-run.js) are rewritten to the actual convention — exit code 1 now carries one meaning only, a verdict or figure disagreeing with its expectation, while parse failures, structural gaps and uncaught exceptions all land on exit code 2. Two further items are fixed: S4-1 (lines 1325-1332 of seb-tabletop-run.js add a component-engagement section, so a reader can see whether a criteria group ran at all rather than merely that it exists) and S4-3 (lines 966-973 of seb-op04-chain-run.js drop the two-level fallback from a row-level figure to a global default, reporting an absent field as absent). The gate-side items S3-3 and S3-4 are carried by a new file, visual/assets/seb-crosscheck-run.js, which issues no SEB verdict and does one thing: it turns the readings and promises PG-10 used to record as prose into executable assertions, in three groups. [A] compares both checkers' exit codes and every summary reading against expectations pinned in the script. [B] has each implementation export the set of codes it can emit this run (--print-emittable-codes), requires every one to be registered in the baseline registry and every registered code to be emittable by at least one implementation, in both directions. [C] feeds one illegal input to both implementations and requires equal exit codes equal to the expectation, across five mutations in this batch: a control, the whole registry deleted, the gate code renamed to an unregistered value, the baseline truncated to invalid JSON, and the node_schema component removed. Both checkers gained a code-set export branch that fires only on an explicit flag (lines 1170-1173 and 688-691), leaving default output unchanged to the letter. New baseline readings: the tabletop checker exits 0 with sixty-two fixtures matching expectation at 62 of 62 (23 accepted, 39 rejected); the chain replayer exits 0 with 4 of 4 claims matching and zero disagreeing figures, its excerpt of the prerequisite checker now reading 62 of 62; and the cross-check exits 0 with 40 and 23 emittable codes against a 40-code registry agreeing in both directions and both implementations returning one verdict on each of the five mutations. Of the sixteen missed detections that exited 0 before the fix, none exits 0 after it.

not_adopted_reason.zh: verdict 为 adopted，本字段登记本批明确未修的三项缺口与其理由，以及一项刻意不做的事。其一，S2-3：证据链复演器内 v0.4.0 生命周期、权限边界与测量声明三组判据在本档案输入类型下零覆盖（正负均无，档案的等级申报、权限声明与测量声明各为零条），约三百行判据代码只靠注释声明「触发即判」。本批不修，因为要使其有覆盖必须向 seb-op04-chain-data.json 注入本包并不存在的输入类型，属档案语义变更而非实现加固，超出本次授权范围；该三组判据在桌面校验器一侧有正反样例覆盖，故不是零覆盖，只是不在这一实现内。其二，证据链复演器的选点依据条数与声明条数目前只有零条下界与唯一性断言，没有像样例集那样的绝对定数比对，原因是 seb-op04-chain-data.json 尚未声明相应的期望条数键；补键属档案变更，与其一同批处理，本批只把下界与集合双向比对做实。其三，S4-2：桌面校验器的 skipped 统计仍只覆盖等级定义、判定规则与双联交接三个组件，不含来源对齐、测量声明与权限边界；本批以第 1325-1332 行的组件执行次数段从另一侧提供了同类信息，跳过统计本身的口径扩展留待下一批。刻意不做的一项：不把审计中被判为「已核无异」的部分写成新的通过性断言——例如毫米级灵敏度与前置链真实执行，这两件事本来就成立，把它们补写成断言只会增加自检的行数而不增加自检的效力。
not_adopted_reason.en: The verdict is adopted; this field registers the three gaps expressly left open in this batch with their reasons, and one thing deliberately not done. First, S2-3: inside the chain replayer the v0.4.0 lifecycle, authority-boundary and measurement-declaration criteria have zero coverage under this archive's input type, positive and negative alike (the archive declares no level claim, no authority declaration and no measurement declaration), leaving some three hundred lines of criteria asserting in comments alone that they would fire. They are not addressed here because giving them coverage would require injecting into seb-op04-chain-data.json input types this package does not contain, which is a change of archive semantics rather than a hardening of an implementation and lies outside this authorisation; the same three groups do carry positive and negative fixtures on the tabletop side, so the coverage is absent from this implementation, not from the package. Second, the selection checks and claims of the chain replayer currently carry only a zero floor and a uniqueness assertion, not an absolute declared count as the fixture set now does, because seb-op04-chain-data.json declares no corresponding expected-count key; adding one is an archive change and travels with the first item, so this batch makes only the floors and the set comparisons real. Third, S4-2: the tabletop checker's skipped statistic still covers only the level definitions, decision rules and handover ledger, not source alignment, measurement declarations or the authority boundary; the component-engagement section at lines 1325-1332 supplies the same kind of information from the other side, and widening the skipped statistic itself is left to a later batch. The thing deliberately not done: nothing the audit found sound was rewritten into a new passing assertion — millimetre sensitivity and the genuine execution of the prerequisite chain already held, and restating them as assertions would add lines to the self-check without adding force to it.

failed_sample_register.register_note_zh: 本批九条失败样本全部由维护方对随包自检脚本的内部对抗性审计查获，不是由任何一次正常运行、任何注入样例或任何外部评审提出。逐条如实登记发现方式，是因为九条中有七条的修前行为恰恰是「退出码 0、输出与干净运行逐字节相同」——它们在正常运行下无法显形，把它们记成「本工具自查发现」会是第二次同型的自我证明。审计方法：整包只读拷贝，逐项施加变异并记录退出码与输出差异，共四十四组。
failed_sample_register.register_note_en: All nine failed samples in this batch were found by the maintainer's internal adversarial audit of the shipped self-check scripts, and by no clean run, no injected fixture and no external review. The means of discovery is registered plainly for each because in seven of the nine the pre-fix behaviour was precisely exit code 0 with output byte-identical to a clean run: they could not surface under a clean run, and recording them as found by the tool's own self-check would be a second instance of the same self-proof. Method: a read-only copy of the whole package, with mutations applied item by item and exit codes and output differences recorded, forty-four in all.

samples.description_zh: 元检查在自己的输入缺席时把自己关掉：桌面校验器的码集自检以「登记表不存在即无问题可报」收场（原 seb-tabletop-run.js 第 244 行 if (!registry) return []）。审计变异 T-M14 删掉整张 violation_code_registry.codes 后，校验器输出与干净运行逐字节相同并退出 0；同一份输入在证据链复演器一侧以退出码 2 拒绝，两个实现对同一非法输入当场分歧。
samples.description_en: A meta-check switching itself off when its own input is absent: the tabletop checker's code self-check ended at "no registry, nothing to report" (line 244 of the former seb-tabletop-run.js, if (!registry) return []). Under audit mutation T-M14, deleting the whole violation_code_registry.codes table left output byte-identical to a clean run at exit 0, while the same input drew a refusal at exit 2 from the chain replayer — the two implementations disagreeing on one illegal input.
samples.disposition_zh: seb-tabletop-run.js 第 283-285 行改为返回「登记表缺失，码集自检无从执行，不作判定」并整次拒绝，与第二实现同判。复跑 T-M14：退出码由 0 变 2。发现方式为内部对抗性审计的定向变异，不是本工具自身的任何一次运行——同 FS-067 的登记姿态，此处如实写明：该缺陷在数十次「全部通过」的正常运行中从未显形，正常运行本来也不可能显形它。
samples.disposition_en: Lines 283-285 of seb-tabletop-run.js now return "the registry is absent, the code self-check cannot run and no verdict is issued" and refuse the run, matching the second implementation. Re-running T-M14 moves the exit code from 0 to 2. This was found by a targeted mutation in an internal adversarial audit and by no run of the tool itself — registered in the same posture as FS-067, and stated plainly: the defect never showed in dozens of clean "all passed" runs, and a clean run could never have shown it.

samples.description_zh: 可发判定码的自检集合与实际发出的码不同源：两个实现的码全集都由字面量拼出，而运行时真正发出的等级闸门码与分母完整性码读自基准的 level_definitions.gate_violation_code 与 scoring_definitions.denominator_integrity_violation_code。审计变异 X-CODE-T 与 X-CODE-O 把 gate_violation_code 改成未登记的 UNREGISTERED_GATE_CODE 并同步期望后，两个实现均退出 0，证据链复演器还照常打印「二十三个可发码全部登记在基准登记表内」——自检报告的内容与事实相反。
samples.description_en: The self-checked set of emittable verdict codes drew on a different source from the codes actually emitted: both implementations composed their sets from literals, while the level-gate code and the denominator-integrity code emitted at run time were read from the baseline's level_definitions.gate_violation_code and scoring_definitions.denominator_integrity_violation_code. Under audit mutations X-CODE-T and X-CODE-O, renaming gate_violation_code to an unregistered UNREGISTERED_GATE_CODE with expectations updated to match, both implementations exited 0 and the chain replayer went on printing that all twenty-three emittable codes were registered — a self-check reporting the opposite of the fact.
samples.disposition_zh: 两个码从 seb-tabletop-run.js 第 154 行起的字面量表中移除并在第 143-153 行注明理由，改由第 258-261 行读基准值登记；seb-op04-chain-run.js 第 649-656 行同样把字面量种子集缩到本实现自己拼出的码，字段规则码与等级闸门码一律读基准值。第 698 行的自检文案未改动，但其真值条件此后由「集合与实际发出值同源」保证，而不再由字面量表的巧合保证。复跑 X-CODE-T 与 X-CODE-O：两侧退出码均由 0 变 2。
samples.disposition_en: Both codes were removed from the literal table at line 154 of seb-tabletop-run.js, with the reason stated at lines 143-153, and are now registered from the baseline values at lines 258-261; lines 649-656 of seb-op04-chain-run.js likewise shrink the literal seed set to the codes that implementation composes itself, reading field-rule codes and the level-gate code from the baseline. The wording of the self-check line at 698 is unchanged, but what makes it true is now that the set and the emitted values share one source, rather than a coincidence between two literal tables. Re-running X-CODE-T and X-CODE-O moves both exit codes from 0 to 2.

samples.description_zh: 计算值与档案值之间唯一一道比对的阈值由被审档案自己提供且无上界：证据链复演器的 near() 取 stage_4 的 tolerance_m 作容差。审计变异 O-M10 把容差由 0.0005 改为 10000、全部档案距离读数平移 50 米、derived 段按新读数自洽重算后，复演器退出 0 并报「读数不符项 0」——一份把全部空间读数改错五十米的档案可以自称复演通过。
samples.description_en: The threshold of the only comparison between computed and archived values was supplied by the audited archive itself with no ceiling: the chain replayer's near() took tolerance_m from stage 4. Under audit mutation O-M10, raising the tolerance from 0.0005 to 10000, shifting every archived distance by 50 m and recomputing the derived block to stay self-consistent, the replayer exited 0 reporting zero disagreeing figures — an archive with every spatial figure wrong by fifty metres could call itself replayed.
samples.disposition_zh: seb-op04-chain-run.js 第 903 行设实现侧上界常量 MAX_TOLERANCE_M = 0.01，第 905-911 行校验容差为有限非负数且不超过上界，超限即以退出码 2 拒绝整次复演并写明「档案不得自定超限容差」。上界取值依据：本包全部长度读数按毫米取整，1 厘米已远宽于任何合理的浮点余量。复跑 O-M10：退出码由 0 变 2。
samples.disposition_en: Line 903 of seb-op04-chain-run.js sets the implementation ceiling MAX_TOLERANCE_M = 0.01 and lines 905-911 require the tolerance to be a finite non-negative number no greater than it, refusing the whole replay at exit code 2 above that with the note that an archive may not set its own tolerance beyond the ceiling. The value is grounded in this package rounding every length to the millimetre, against which 1 cm is already far wider than any legitimate floating-point margin. Re-running O-M10 moves the exit code from 0 to 2.

samples.description_zh: stage-4 的行程比、增量与接入比整段是档案除以档案：原 totalOf 与 stubOf 直接读 rows 里的 total_m 与 destination_access_stub_m，即档案自己的期望值，本次算出的行程值从不参与这一段；更进一步，打印给读者看的全程与接入距离同样取自 row，读者以为在看复演结果，实际在看被审档案的入档值。这是 O-M10 能够整体通过的放大器：容差放开后逐行比对失效，而 derived 段因两端同源恒等成立。
samples.description_en: The stage-4 ratios, delta and approach figures were archive divided by archive: totalOf and stubOf read total_m and destination_access_stub_m straight off the rows — the archive's own expectations — with the values computed in the run taking no part; worse, the trip and approach distances printed for the reader came from the same rows, so what looked like a replay result was the audited archive's own entry. This was the amplifier that let O-M10 pass as a whole: with the tolerance opened up the per-row comparison went dead, while the derived block held identically because both its sides came from one source.
samples.disposition_zh: seb-op04-chain-run.js 第 941 行起把每行的计算值（全程、起终点接入段、挂接线、可达性）留存于 computed 表；第 984-987 行改为打印计算值；第 1014-1023 行的 cell/totalOf/stubOf 一律读 computed，某格计算结果缺席即报「比值无从复核」。与 FS-070 的上界合并后，O-M10 在容差一步即被拒绝，derived 段亦不再是重言式。
samples.disposition_en: From line 941 of seb-op04-chain-run.js each row's computed values — total, origin and destination approach stubs, attachment line and reachability — are kept in a computed table; lines 984-987 print those computed values; and cell/totalOf/stubOf at lines 1014-1023 read only from that table, reporting that the ratios cannot be re-checked where a cell is missing. Together with the ceiling of FS-070, O-M10 is refused at the tolerance step and the derived block is no longer a tautology.

samples.description_zh: 反例的期望理由码缺席即静默降级为只比对判定：原判据写作 (!claim.expected_reason_code || 理由命中)，档案删掉这个键，REJECT 只要是 REJECT 就算通过，因什么理由拒绝不再受检。审计变异 O-M2b 删掉两条 expected_reason_code 后，复演器仍报 4／4、读数不符项 0。
samples.description_en: An absent expected reason code silently degraded a counterexample to a verdict-only comparison: the test read (!claim.expected_reason_code || reason matched), so deleting the key from the archive let any REJECT count as agreement whatever its reason. Under audit mutation O-M2b, with two expected_reason_code keys deleted, the replayer still reported 4 of 4 and zero disagreeing figures.
samples.disposition_zh: seb-op04-chain-run.js 第 1117-1133 行改为：期望判定为 REJECT 的声明必须携带非空 expected_reason_code，缺席即记为本条声明不合格而不再是放行条件；理由比对随之成为反例的必要条件。复跑 O-M2b：退出码由 0 变 1，并逐条报出缺码的声明标识。
samples.disposition_en: Lines 1117-1133 of seb-op04-chain-run.js now require any claim expecting REJECT to carry a non-empty expected_reason_code, an absence being a defect in the claim rather than a free pass, which makes the reason comparison a necessary condition for a counterexample. Re-running O-M2b moves the exit code from 0 to 1 and names each claim missing its code.

samples.description_zh: 条件式登记使整块校验随档案子键一同消失：stage-4 的两组接入比校验写作 if (der.<键>) { … }，档案删掉那个子键，对应校验整块不执行且不留任何痕迹。审计变异 O-M5 删掉 derived.alt_b_approach_ratio_over_ai_on 后，复演器退出 0、读数不符项 0，与基线相比仅少两行输出。
samples.description_en: Conditional registration let a whole check vanish with an archive sub-key: the two approach-ratio checks of stage 4 were written as if (der.<key>) { … }, so deleting that sub-key from the archive skipped the block entirely without a trace. Under audit mutation O-M5, with derived.alt_b_approach_ratio_over_ai_on deleted, the replayer exited 0 with zero disagreeing figures, its output shorter by two lines and otherwise identical.
samples.disposition_zh: seb-op04-chain-run.js 第 1001-1008 行把 derived 的必检键写成常量清单：三项行程读数在任何档案版次下逐个点名必检，接入距离比因 v0.2 与 v0.3 两种口径键名不同，要求两者至少声明其一；缺键即报。第 1029 与 1039 行的两处条件判断由真值判断改为 !== undefined，使读数为零不再等同于键不存在。复跑 O-M5：退出码由 0 变 1。
samples.disposition_en: Lines 1001-1008 of seb-op04-chain-run.js name the required derived keys as a constant list: the three trip figures are required under every archive revision, and since the approach ratio carries different key names under the v0.2 and v0.3 conventions, at least one of the two must be declared; any absence is reported. The two conditionals at lines 1029 and 1039 move from truthiness to !== undefined, so a reading of zero no longer reads as an absent key. Re-running O-M5 moves the exit code from 0 to 1.

samples.description_zh: 两个校验器都没有任何期望总数或下界断言，「少跑一项」与「全部通过」在输出上不可区分：桌面校验器的循环完全由样例数组驱动，证据链复演器的行、选点依据与声明循环完全由被审档案驱动。审计实测——删一条样例得 59／59 退出 0（T-M1a、T-M1b）；样例数组清空得 0／0 退出 0（T-M10）；样例复制成一百二十条得 120／120 退出 0（T-M12）；删 stage-4 一行、清空 selection_checks、清空 claims 均退出 0 且报「读数不符项 0」（O-M1、O-M8、O-M1b）。
samples.description_en: Neither checker carried an expected total or a floor assertion, leaving one item fewer indistinguishable from a full pass: the tabletop loop was driven entirely by the fixture array and the chain replayer's row, selection-check and claim loops entirely by the audited archive. Measured in the audit: deleting one fixture gave 59 of 59 at exit 0 (T-M1a, T-M1b); emptying the array gave 0 of 0 at exit 0 (T-M10); duplicating the set to one hundred and twenty gave 120 of 120 at exit 0 (T-M12); and deleting a stage-4 row, emptying selection_checks and emptying the claims each exited 0 reporting zero disagreeing figures (O-M1, O-M8, O-M1b).
samples.disposition_zh: 样例集在 seb-tabletop-fixtures.json 顶层声明 expected_fixture_count 62、expected_accept_count 23、expected_reject_count 39；seb-tabletop-run.js 第 370-406 行读入后与实跑条目逐项比对，不等、缺声明键或条目数为零一律退出码 2，标识唯一性与逐样例必备字段同处校验；第 1336-1340 行把这三项比对结果作为可读读数打印在汇总段。证据链复演器一侧：第 921-935 行把应有行数改由实现侧状态集与档案任务清单交叉相乘得出，缺行、多行与重复行逐条报出；第 745-752 行为选点依据设零条下界；第 1100-1111 行为声明集设零条下界、标识唯一性与「至少一条反例」下界；第 1181 行的收尾条件加入声明数大于零。复跑六项变异：全部由退出 0 变为退出 1 或 2。口径变化一并登记：翻转一条样例期望（审计变异 T-M2）此前得 59／60、退出 1，现因正反两侧声明计数与实到条目不符而先于判定被拒，退出码由 1 变 2——数据不自洽的优先级高于判定不一致，这是本次引入声明式计数的直接后果。
samples.disposition_en: The fixture set declares expected_fixture_count 62, expected_accept_count 23 and expected_reject_count 39 at the top level of seb-tabletop-fixtures.json; lines 370-406 of seb-tabletop-run.js read them and compare each against what actually ran, refusing at exit code 2 on any disagreement, any missing declaration or an empty set, with identifier uniqueness and the per-fixture mandatory fields checked in the same place, and lines 1336-1340 print the three comparisons as a readable figure in the summary. On the chain side: lines 921-935 derive how many rows there should be from the cross product of the implementation's state set and the archive's task list, reporting missing, extra and duplicate rows one by one; lines 745-752 set a zero floor for the selection checks; lines 1100-1111 set a zero floor, identifier uniqueness and an at-least-one-counterexample floor for the claim set; and line 1181 adds a non-empty claim set to the closing condition. Re-running the six mutations moves every one of them from exit 0 to exit 1 or 2. One change of convention is registered with it: flipping a single fixture expectation (audit mutation T-M2) used to give 59 of 60 at exit 1 and is now refused before any verdict is reached, at exit 2, because the declared polarity counts no longer match what arrived — data that disagrees with itself outranks a verdict that disagrees with its expectation, which is the direct consequence of introducing declared counts.

samples.description_zh: 几何要素只被正向遍历，缺席即连同其校验一起消失：证据链复演器逐条走 roads.geojson 中的线位与入档长度比对，却不反向核对入档长度表与 AI 关闭态分类表的键集。审计变异 O-M12 与 O-M13 分别删掉 ROAD-002 与 ROAD-003 后，复演器退出 0，且照常打印硬编码文案「五条中心线长度逐条与入档一致」，实际只核了四条——漏检之外另有一句与事实不符的表述。
samples.description_en: Geometry features were walked in one direction only, so an absent feature took its checks with it: the chain replayer compared each centreline in roads.geojson against its archived length without ever checking the archived length table or the AI-off classification table back against the geometry. Under audit mutations O-M12 and O-M13, deleting ROAD-002 and ROAD-003 respectively, the replayer exited 0 and went on printing the hard-coded line that all five centreline lengths matched, having checked four — a false statement on top of a missed detection.
samples.disposition_zh: seb-op04-chain-run.js 第 798-812 行对三处标识集合——几何线位、入档长度表、AI 关闭态分类表——作两两双向比对，任一侧多出即逐条报出；第 817 行的成功文案改由 roads.length 生成，条数不再是写死的字面量。复跑 O-M12 与 O-M13：退出码由 0 变 1，并报出「入档长度表登记的 ROAD-002 不在 roads.geojson 中」。
samples.disposition_en: Lines 798-812 of seb-op04-chain-run.js compare the three identifier sets — geometry centrelines, archived lengths and AI-off classification — against one another in both directions, reporting each id present on one side only; and line 817 composes the success line from roads.length, so the count is no longer a written-in literal. Re-running O-M12 and O-M13 moves the exit code from 0 to 1 with the message that ROAD-002 is archived with a length but absent from roads.geojson.

samples.description_zh: 来源对齐判据零反例覆盖：四十个登记码中三十四个有反例样例，SOURCE_MISMATCH 属逐样例判据却一条反例也没有。审计变异 T-M18 从判定函数中删掉整条来源对齐结论（...alignment.reasons）后，校验器输出与干净运行逐字节相同并退出 0——一条判据可以被整条摘除而无人察觉，说明此前六十条样例的「全部通过」并不覆盖它。
samples.description_en: The source-alignment criterion had zero counterexample coverage: thirty-four of the forty registered codes carried a counterexample fixture, while SOURCE_MISMATCH, a per-fixture criterion, carried none. Under audit mutation T-M18, deleting the whole source-alignment conclusion (...alignment.reasons) from the verdict function left output byte-identical to a clean run at exit 0 — a criterion could be removed wholesale unnoticed, which is what shows the earlier sixty-fixture full pass never covered it.
samples.disposition_zh: seb-tabletop-fixtures.json 新增两条反例，样例集由六十条增至六十二条：SM-N1 覆盖强制对齐一侧（节点标识与 geometry/constraints.geojson 的要素标识相同、未声明来源，五个必填字段中 operating_mode 一项被改写），SM-N2 覆盖声明来源一侧（节点标识为推演用标识，自行声明来源指向 OP-03，responsible_role 一项被改写），两条期望判定均为 reject，期望理由分别为 SOURCE_MISMATCH:operating_mode 与 SOURCE_MISMATCH:responsible_role。另在 seb-tabletop-run.js 第 1002、1015、1018、1029 行为来源对齐结论加 engaged 标记，第 1055 行随判定结果留存，第 1316 行按此统计本轮真实执行次数（本轮 24／62）。复跑 T-M18：退出码由 0 变 1，两条新反例判为 ACCEPT 与期望 REJECT 不一致。
samples.disposition_en: Two counterexamples were added to seb-tabletop-fixtures.json, taking the set from sixty to sixty-two: SM-N1 covers the forced-alignment side (a node id equal to a feature id in geometry/constraints.geojson with no declared source, and operating_mode rewritten among the five required fields) and SM-N2 the declared-source side (a run-local node id declaring OP-03 as its source with responsible_role rewritten), both expecting reject with expected reasons SOURCE_MISMATCH:operating_mode and SOURCE_MISMATCH:responsible_role. Lines 1002, 1015, 1018 and 1029 of seb-tabletop-run.js additionally mark the source-alignment conclusion as engaged, line 1055 keeps that mark with the verdict, and line 1316 counts how many times the criterion truly ran this round (24 of 62 here). Re-running T-M18 moves the exit code from 0 to 1, the two new counterexamples ruling ACCEPT against an expectation of REJECT.

affected_metrics.summary_zh: metrics.json 的七项包容性指标、八字段与全部保持未知的指标键一字未动，三个脚本均不写入 metrics.json，本批不产生任何绩效指标数值。受影响的是自检读数本身，共三项：桌面样例总数由 60 增至 62、拒绝条数由 37 增至 39、与期望一致由 60／60 变为 62／62。变化全部来自 FS-076 补入的两条来源对齐反例，不来自任何判定口径的松紧调整；原六十条样例的字段与期望判定一字未改，逐条判定结果与修前完全相同。OP-04 证据链读数不变（声明判定 4／4、读数不符项 0），其输出中摘录的前置校验器行随桌面读数变为 62／62。新增两条反例不含任何计数、比例或耗时，样例集 contains_no_measurement_values 的承诺在扩充后仍然成立。
affected_metrics.summary_en: The seven inclusion metrics, the eight fields and every kept-unknown key of metrics.json are untouched, none of the three scripts writes to metrics.json, and this batch produces no performance metric value. What changed are the self-check readings themselves, three of them: the tabletop fixture total from 60 to 62, the rejected count from 37 to 39, and matching expectation from 60 of 60 to 62 of 62. All three follow from the two source-alignment counterexamples added under FS-076 and from no loosening or tightening of any verdict convention; the original sixty fixtures keep their fields and expectations to the letter and rule exactly as before. The OP-04 chain figures stand (4 of 4 claims, zero disagreeing figures), with the excerpt of the prerequisite checker in its output following the tabletop reading to 62 of 62. The two new counterexamples hold no count, ratio or duration, so the fixture set's contains_no_measurement_values promise still holds after the extension.

verification.zh: 在 visual/assets 目录下依次运行三条命令：node seb-tabletop-run.js，预期退出码 0、汇总段「与期望一致 : 62 / 62」「通过 23」「拒绝 39」，并出现「条目总数复核 : 声明 62 · 实跑 62」一行；node seb-op04-chain-run.js，预期退出码 0、声明判定 4／4、读数不符项 0，其前置校验器摘录行为 62／62；node seb-crosscheck-run.js，预期退出码 0、断言不成立项 0，[B] 段报桌面 40 个可发码、复演 23 个、登记表 40 个码，[C] 段五组变异两实现退出码逐组相等。基准未变可由 git diff 核对 seb-spec.json 为空，或以 shasum -a 256 与 manifest.json 登记的摘要比对。九条失败样本的修前行为可由第三方在整包只读拷贝上复现：按每条 description 所述施加变异后运行对应校验器，修前退出码与本文所记一致，修后则为所记的新退出码；十六项修前退出 0 的变异，修后无一项仍为 0。本条回执登记的三个读数与 package-integrity-gates.json 的 PG-10 当前读数须逐项相等，不等即以本回执与该闸门中较晚的复测时间戳为准并追查差异来源。
verification.en: Run three commands in turn inside visual/assets. node seb-tabletop-run.js should exit 0 with a summary reading 62 of 62 matching expectation, 23 accepted and 39 rejected, and a line reporting the declared item count as 62 declared against 62 run. node seb-op04-chain-run.js should exit 0 with 4 of 4 claims and zero disagreeing figures, its excerpt of the prerequisite checker reading 62 of 62. node seb-crosscheck-run.js should exit 0 with no failing assertion, group [B] reporting 40 emittable codes for the tabletop checker, 23 for the chain replay and 40 registered codes, and group [C] returning equal exit codes from both implementations on each of the five mutations. That the baseline did not change can be checked with an empty git diff on seb-spec.json, or by comparing shasum -a 256 against the digest registered in manifest.json. The pre-fix behaviour of the nine failed samples is reproducible by a third party on a read-only copy of the package: apply the mutation described in each entry and run the corresponding checker, where the pre-fix exit code matches what is recorded here and the post-fix code matches the new one recorded; of the sixteen mutations that exited 0 before the fix, none exits 0 after it. The three readings registered here must equal item for item the current reading of gate PG-10 in package-integrity-gates.json; where they do not, the later of the two remeasurement timestamps governs and the source of the difference is to be traced.
